column236: Very interesting survey. A huge amount of work put into preparing the projects and the survey - bravo. The task shows that it is hard for us to break away from solutions that we already know from everyday life. Even when using AI, real thinking or deciding on solutions "out of the box" that radically change the approach to the subject is a small percentage. In AI, such input, such output - it will not make us more creative, but it helps to gather our thoughts together. Of course, I understand that some topics are difficult to change radically (limits imposed by public transport, "a tram is a tram, you won't go crazy"), but if the topic is the Tram of the Future, then radical solutions such as a hanging tram must appear. A specific change and a specific benefit (fewer traffic jams) - I like that. On the other hand, aesthetically all the works are very nice. Congratulations on the great work put in by the students and the teachers! Best regards

Biorąc pod uwagę tramwaje przyszłości nie oczekuje się, że będą poruszać się po dwóch szynach czy będą miały zasilanie z drutów pod napięciem zlokalizowanymi standardowo nad nimi. AI zmieniło kształty siedzeń, pokazało irracjonalnie wielkie przeszklenia czy "turbo nowoczesne" ledy. Nie przedstawiono rozwiązań innowacyjnych. Co najwyżej połączone istniejące rozwiazania z kształtami prototypów pojazdow przyszłości jakie znamy - od obłych z paskami led po ciosane jak Tesla cybertruck. Był też nawet dobrze designersko zgrany. Ogólnie średnia ocena wszystkich projektów to 2/5 pod względem designu i 1/5 pod względem innowacyjności i zaskoczenia.
column236: One gets the impression that there is no innovation in these projects. Considering the trams of the future, it is not expected that they will move on two rails or have power from live wires located above them as standard. AI changed the shapes of the seats, showed irrationally large glazing or "turbo modern" LEDs. No innovative solutions were presented. At most, existing solutions were combined with the shapes of prototypes of vehicles of the future as we know them - from rounded ones with LED strips to hewn like a Tesla cybertruck. Only one project caught attention, which assumed that the tram is suspended and moves on an inverted track. It is not overly clever, but it is the only project that introduces something different. It was also well-coordinated in terms of design. Overall, the average rating of all projects is 2/5 in terms of design and 1/5 in terms of innovation and surprise.
